title: Palantir graph connectivity and person inclusion rationale
summary: Machine-readable explanation of why named people appear in the 1789, executive-branch, EO 14243 and Vulcan/OSC graph branches, with explicit evidence limits.

sources.title: Executive Order 14243 — Stopping Waste, Fraud, and Abuse by Eliminating Information Silos
Office of Strategic Capital Agrees to Joint $700M Conditional Loan Commitment
Company Tied to Donald Trump Jr. Got a Deal After White House Intervened

data.question: Why is each named person listed, and which explicit edges connect previously isolated nodes?
data.method: Repository graph audit followed by conversion of metadata-only roles and embedded endpoints into explicit canonical string-ID relation records; source-backed inclusion rationale recorded separately from allegation or inference.
data.framework: Canonical graph repair: metadata-only role arrays and embedded relation endpoints are converted into explicit edges; roles and affiliations explain inclusion but are not treated as misconduct; conditional financing remains distinct from closing and disbursement; contested reporting remains attributed.
data.scope: 1789 Capital, Rockbridge Network, Thiel Capital, OSTP, State Department, EO 14243, Vulcan Elements and the Office of Strategic Capital.
findings: Chris Buskirk is listed because he bridges Rockbridge Network and 1789 Capital through documented co-founder roles; those roles do not establish control over public decisions.
Omeed Malik is listed because he founded and leads 1789 Capital and is reported as a private Executive Branch club co-founder; affiliation is not proof of quid pro quo.

Donald Trump Jr. is listed because he is a 1789 Capital partner and reported private-club co-founder; no reviewed source establishes that he requested, shaped or knew in advance about Vulcan's OSC commitment, and he and 1789 denied involvement.

Michael Kratsios is listed because official records connect a former Thiel Capital principal role to current direction of White House OSTP; the career sequence does not establish Palantir-specific influence or misconduct.

Jacob Helberg is listed because disclosure records connect him to Palantir CEO Alex Karp and the Senate confirmed him as a State Department under secretary; the career sequence does not establish procurement influence or misconduct.

Peter Navarro is listed because ProPublica attributed the request initiating or accelerating Vulcan's OSC review to him; this remains attributed and contested and does not establish a request from Trump Jr., preferential treatment, skipped diligence, closing or disbursement.
Donald Trump is listed as the issuer of EO 14243; the order is vendor-neutral and does not name Palantir.

Peter Thiel is listed as the founder-network endpoint connecting Palantir, Thiel Capital and the existing venture branch; founder and investment roles do not establish command over officials or awards.
Alex Karp is listed as the canonical Palantir CEO endpoint needed to resolve Jacob Helberg's previously embedded adviser relation.

The repaired paths are Buskirk to Rockbridge and 1789; Malik and Donald Trump Jr. to 1789; 1789 through the Vulcan Series A to Vulcan; Thiel through Thiel Capital and Kratsios to OSTP and the executive branch; Helberg to Karp and State; Trump through EO 14243 to the executive branch; and Navarro through an attributed request edge to the OSC commitment event.
conclusions: The visible fragmentation was primarily a representation problem rather than absence of underlying facts.
Explicit canonical relation records connect the side branches while preserving distinct evidentiary meanings.
The strongest supported statements are roles, career transitions, policy issuance, disclosed investment and a conditional financing announcement.
The Navarro edge remains attributed and contested, and the Vulcan financing remains conditional unless closing and disbursement records are produced.
counterarguments: Officials may have been selected for competence independent of prior affiliations.
EO 14243 applies government-wide and is vendor-neutral.
Investment and access-network overlap do not prove intervention or causation.
The named parties denied preferential treatment or relevant involvement in the Vulcan financing process.
limitations: Primary White House-OSC-Pentagon communications were not retrieved.
Vulcan credit-review, closing and disbursement records remain unresolved.
Kratsios and Helberg ethics agreements, recusals and participation records remain incomplete.
Private-club membership and event ledgers remain incomplete.
unresolved: Vulcan credit review, conditions precedent, closing and disbursement
Kratsios and Helberg ethics agreements, recusals and participation records
Executive Branch club membership, event and official-contact ledger

caveats: This pass repairs graph connectivity; it does not resolve all underlying ethics, access or financing records.
